question: Related Questions Q. I am from India & presently working in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. I follow the Hanafi maslak. Sometimes due to work related travel I mis the jamat of Zohar salah. But I try to reach the masjid at the earliest to perform my Zohar salah. But sometime it happens that when I reach the masjid I find that Asar Jamat (as per Hambali timing) has started. But as per Hanafi salah timetable I still have time for our Zohar salah, as Asar time has not started as per Hanafi timetable. Now my question is what should I do? Do i read the Zohar salah first & then try to join the jamat of Asar which has already started may be the jamat may be over before I complete my Zohar salah. or I directly join the jamat for Asar salah & read my Zohar after that? I am very confused. answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 4277 Country: India Title: I AM HANFY CAN I READ TWO NAMAZ IN ONE TIME IN ANY CONDITION. Question: I AM HANFY CAN I READ TWO NAMAZ IN ONE TIME IN ANY CONDITION. Answer ID: 4277 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 339/399=M/1429) On the occasion of Hajj, it is not allowed for a haji to combine two salah in any condition except in Arafat and Muzdalifah. However, in a state of compulsion, one is allowed to perform two s alah in a way that first salah is prayed in the last time and the second s alah in its initial time. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
